title: Trump made US midterms about himself. Will it backfire?

blocks.text: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump’s strategy for the US midterm elections has one main ingredient — more Donald Trump. But his historic unpopularity may hinder Republicans instead of helping them. Trump has blitzed the campaign trail in the month before the November 3 vote, jetting across the country for near-daily rallies in the fervent belief that he alone can fire up his MAGA base. Add a sprinkle of insults painting Democrats as communists or fans of “transgender mutilization”, add some promises of cash if Republicans win, and you have Trump’s recipe for defying the polls.
